comparison.objective: Seat a servo horn on a splined shaft at the zero angular index.
comparison.physical_skill: Small-part grasping, coaxial and angular alignment, and controlled axial pressing.
comparison.success_condition: Horn seated flush at the zero spline index, stationary, released, and not left on a wrong tooth.
comparison.reason: Both require precision alignment, but this record tests indexed spline registration and press seating. It does not test maintaining a continuous support path while translating an uncaged recirculating carriage without losing elements.
